_comments: WHETHER A REGISTERED ORDER-LINE VETO WOULD REFUSE AN EDIT (bizapps-sales#328). Its own dot-json so it conflicts with
no other change to the remote operations. Called by the order lines editor to show lines read-only.

fields.Name: Check Order Lines Editable
fields.Description: Whether the order-line veto another app registered on this host would refuse adding, changing or removing a line of a saved order, and the refusal it would give. Read-only. Asks the same veto the line save asks, as the caller, so the editor can show lines read-only before anyone types a change the save would refuse. A vetoer that fails counts as a refusal. With no vetoer registered, every answer is null.
